{"reason": "All 4 stockouts came from the 34 suggest-alternative-supplier rows (alt lead 4-7d vs 2.8-5.3d inventory). Alert-planner costs 35000 vs 45000 and always arrives on time, so it strictly dominates; swapping the medium+ branch action cuts cost to ~1.225M and removes every stockout.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
